title: Forecasting Patient Demand at Urgent Care Clinics using Machine Learning
summary: statistical/ML ensemble forecasting improved 90-day patient-demand estimates for two Auckland urgent-care clinics on 2011–2021 data; later journal results refine the improvement range, and no deployment or patient-outcome effect is shown.
ai_technology: Eight statistical/ML algorithms and ensembles evaluated on two clinics’ daily arrivals, with XAI analysis.
